intro: My current teaching focuses on applied microeconomics and managerial economics, with a particular emphasis on using economic frameworks to understand public policy and firm behavior. Over the years I have taught microeconomics, international economics, labor economics and the global economic environment to undergraduates, master's students (including MBA and specialized master programs) and senior executives, using case-based discussions, tutorials, and synchronous and asynchronous online learning. More recently I have been involved as an instructor in initiatives aimed at integrating Artificial Intelligence into economics education.
